prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” agency — the right pick depends on your goals, budget, service needs, audience and compliance requirements. I can recommend agencies, but first it helps to know what “best” means for you.

Quick checklist of what matters when choosing a healthcare marketing agency
- Type of organization: hospital system, specialty clinic, private practice, med device, pharma, payer, B2B, public health campaign.
- Primary goals: patient acquisition, physician referrals, brand building, product launches, clinical trial recruitment, internal communications.
- Core services needed: digital ads, SEO, content/PR, social, creative/branding, CRM/email, web design, analytics, HIPAA-compliant marketing, support for regulated product claims.
- Budget and timeline.
- Geographic scope: local (St. Louis metro), regional, national.
- Preference for local presence vs. remote/national shop.
- Need for diversity or multicultural marketing expertise.

If you want, I can:
- Compile a tailored shortlist (3–5) of St. Louis agencies that specialize in healthcare, with a one-paragraph summary of strengths, representative case studies, team size, and fee estimate.
- Or send a short RFP template and a set of interview questions to evaluate agencies.

Tell me:
1) What type of healthcare organization are you? 2) Top 1–2 goals. 3) Approximate monthly or project budget. 4) Do you require a local St. Louis office?

I’ll use that to recommend the best-fit agencies.
